summary: Check whether every item satisfies the same rule.
documentation: every checks assigned array elements until one predicate result is falsy. If all tested elements pass, it returns true. An empty array also returns true.
inputs: An array and a predicate callback.
returns: A boolean representing whether every tested element passed.
caution: An empty collection passes every. If a real workflow also requires at least one record, check its length separately.
scenarios: Check that every order line is ready before dispatch.
Confirm that all required checklist items are complete.
Validate every imported record before accepting a batch.
title: Check the completion flags
problem: Given tasks with a complete property, return true only if every task has complete === true. For this exercise an empty list returns true.
goal: Use Array.every() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Use every and a strict boolean comparison.
